acid_flask.name: Acid Flask
acid_flask.description: Throw a flask that deals 4 damage and shreds 4 armour from everything in 3 blocks for 8 s.

arrow_rain.name: Arrow Rain
arrow_rain.description: A volley of 10 arrows falls on the spot you look at (within 24 blocks), spread over 4 blocks.

challenge.name: Challenge
challenge.description: Taunt every enemy within 10 blocks to attack you for 6 s; you take 15% less damage while they do.

chum_the_water.name: Chum the Water
chum_the_water.description: For 60 s, fish bite twice as fast within 8 blocks of the spot you look at.

deep_breath.name: Deep Breath
deep_breath.description: Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 60 s.

elixir_of_vigor.name: Elixir of Vigor
elixir_of_vigor.description: Drink: Strength I, Speed I and Haste I for 30 s.

feral_bond.name: Feral Bond
feral_bond.description: For 12 s you share damage with your nearest tamed animal: each of you takes half of what either takes.

fisher_net_throw.name: Net Throw
fisher_net_throw.description: Throw a net that roots every creature in a 3-block area for 3 s.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.description: A quick 3-hit combo on the enemy in front, each hit 60% of your attack damage.

forest_friend.name: Forest Friend
forest_friend.description: In a forest biome: Regeneration I and +10% speed for 30 s.

grappling_rope.name: Grappling Rope
grappling_rope.description: Fire a rope that pulls the creature you hit toward you (no pulling yourself).

hard_hat.name: Hard Hat
hard_hat.description: For 30 s: Resistance I and immunity to damage from falling blocks and suffocation.

hook_and_reel.name: Hook and Reel
hook_and_reel.description: Cast a hook that pulls the creature you hit 6 blocks toward you.

log_throw.name: Log Throw
log_throw.description: Hurl a log that rolls 10 blocks forward, hitting enemies for 6 damage and knocking them back.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.description: Thrust forward 4 blocks along the ground, hitting the first enemy for +50% damage.

mend_beast.name: Mend Beast
mend_beast.description: Heal every tamed animal within 12 blocks for 10 and give them Regeneration I for 10 s.

miner_s_lamp.name: Miner's Lamp
miner_s_lamp.description: Night Vision for 3 minutes and a 5-block light that follows you.

mounted_charge.name: Mounted Charge
mounted_charge.description: While riding: your mount surges forward for 3 s at double speed; enemies you run into take 6 damage and are knocked back.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.description: For 30 s: +20% speed and step up full blocks without jumping.

pickaxe_strike.name: Pickaxe Strike
pickaxe_strike.description: A heavy blow with a pickaxe for +60% damage that shreds 4 armour for 8 s.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.description: Your next arrow roots the target in place for 3 s.

quiver_refill.name: Quiver Refill
quiver_refill.description: Conjure 16 arrows into your inventory (once every 2 minutes).

riposte_stance.name: Riposte Stance
riposte_stance.description: For 6 s, every melee hit you take is answered with an automatic counter for 75% of your attack damage.

rogue_caltrops.name: Caltrops
rogue_caltrops.description: Scatter caltrops in a 3-block area for 10 s: enemies walking over them take 2 damage and get Slowness II.

rogue_smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
rogue_smoke_bomb.description: Throw a smoke cloud (4 blocks, 6 s): enemies inside get Blindness and lose track of you; you get Invisibility while inside.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Restore all your stamina and hunger once every 5 minutes.

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.description: 3 summoned boars charge forward 12 blocks, knocking enemies aside and dealing 5 damage each.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.description: For 30 s the boat or ship you ride goes 40% faster.

trample.name: Trample
trample.description: While riding: enemies within 2 blocks of your mount take 3 damage a second for 6 s.

unhorse.name: Unhorse
unhorse.description: Knock the target off whatever it rides and stun it for 2 s.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Become invisible for 6 s and drop the aggro of every enemy within 16 blocks.

volatile_mix.name: Volatile Mix
volatile_mix.description: Throw a flask that bursts into a random harmful cloud (poison, slowness, weakness or blindness) for 6 s.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: Shout: you and allies within 8 blocks get Strength I for 8 s; enemies within 8 blocks get Weakness I for 5 s.

warrior_shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
warrior_shield_bash.description: Strike with your shield: the enemy in front takes 4 damage, is knocked back 3 blocks and is stunned for 1 s. Needs a shield.

weather_eye.name: Weather Eye
weather_eye.description: See the weather for the next 10 minutes and get Conduit Power for 30 s.

woodsman_s_grit.name: Woodsman's Grit
woodsman_s_grit.description: For 15 s: Resistance I and Haste II.
